probeResult: 1 failing test (defect evidence), 3 passing (boundary sanity, mint demo, inert-mint observation)

findings.claim: A persisted pity streak above ENHANCE_PITY_THRESHOLD (10) is unproducible. EquipmentSystem.enhance only ever persists a streak in [0, 10]: the attempt running at streak >= 10 is a guaranteed success that resets the counter to 0, and failures only increment by 1. validateGameSaveShape checks the field with requireNonNegativeNumber only, so the impossible claim is accepted.
findings.repro: Probe 'rejects enhanceFailStreak > ENHANCE_PITY_THRESHOLD (writer only persists <= threshold)' FAILS: validateGameSaveShape returns ok=true for equipmentSlots=[{slot:'weapon', enhanceLevel:0, enhanceFailStreak:11}] on an otherwise-committed save. Control in same file: streak=10 is accepted legitimately (producible).
findings.mintPath: Load save -> next enhance() call on that slot -> pityGuaranteed fires -> guaranteed success, enhanceLevel +1, streak resets to 0. Demonstrated: slotManager restored with streak 11, random()=>1 (unwinnable roll) returns ok:true, enhanceLevel 0->1; control slot with streak 0 fails on the same roll ('enhance_failed').
findings.impact: Single-shot: exactly one free enhance success, same mint the reachable streak=10 already grants. No unbounded amplification possible (success resets streak to 0). Severity low.

findings.surface: alchemyJobs[] - recipe.realmId vs player.realmId bind absent
findings.claim: A coherent forged job on a recipe whose realmId exceeds the player's realm is accepted: every owned bound passes (recipe/pill/herb/span/room/slot coherence) but recipe.realmId is not checked against player.realmId.
findings.repro: Probe 'accepts a coherent job on a recipe realm above the player, settle delivers a realm-inert pill' PASSES: forged {jobId:'j1', recipeId:'alchemy_tu_linh_dan_foundation_establishment', ...} on a committed qi_refining save passes validateGameSaveShape.
findings.mintPath: AlchemySystem.tick settles the job and delivers the authored pill (tu_linh_dan_foundation_establishment) into the pill bag - but the minted record is realm-inert: usePill exact-realm gate refuses it for a qi_refining player ('wrong_realm'), it cannot be consumed or sold for stones. No live effect reachable; gap is acceptance-hygiene only.
findings.impact: No live mint. Same inert-settle class as scope-hidden recipe families (parked, then settled to unsellable/wrong-realm pills). Tracked as an observation, not a defect.
